# Security policy

## Supported versions

Until {{package}} is on CRAN, only the development version on `main` gets fixes. After that, the latest CRAN release
does.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue. Use GitHub's private reporting instead: on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/{{owner}}/{{package}}/security), choose **Report a vulnerability**. If you can't,
email {{email}} with "{{package}} security" in the subject.

Include your {{package}} version (`packageVersion("{{package}}")`) and a small example with synthetic data.

## What happens next

You'll get an acknowledgement. A confirmed problem is fixed in a new release, described in `NEWS.md`, with credit
if you want it. Please keep the details private until then.
